headline: Anthony Geraci approved as Burlington police chief, 10-2; curbside recycling ordinance sent to committee.
summary: Residents spoke during public forum about City Hall Park, policing, and police accountability. Joanna Grossman was approved for the Church Street Marketplace Commission, and Bruce Wilson was confirmed for the Winooski Valley Park District after Robert O'Brien did not get enough votes. Two tobacco licenses passed 10-2 each, and Vermont Comedy Arts received an indoor entertainment permit.
decisions: Approved John Ellis-Stilli for the Development Review Board alternate seat, with a term expiring June 30th, 2027.
Failed a motion to end debate on the police chief appointment, 2 yes and 10 no.
Confirmed Anthony Geraci as Burlington police chief, 10-2.
Approved an indoor entertainment permit for Vermont Comedy Arts at 118 Main Street, unanimously.
Approved the tobacco substitute endorsement for Henry Street Deli Mart at 11 Henry Street, 10-2.
Approved tobacco licenses for Wolf's Convenience Store at 457 St. Paul Street, 10-2.
Approved Joanna Grossman for the Church Street Marketplace Commission, 7 yes and 5 abstentions.
Did not approve Robert O'Brien for the Winooski Valley Park District seat; he received 4 yes votes and 8 abstentions.
Approved Bruce Wilson for the Winooski Valley Park District seat, 8 yes and 4 abstentions.
Referred the curbside recycling ordinance change to the Ordinance Committee after waiving the first reading.
Postponed the Winooski Valley Park District FY26 annual report and FY28 budget request to November 23rd.
discussion: Police chief appointment: Opponents said the search was rushed and a candidate's past was not fully reviewed. Supporters said the process was thorough and the department needs stability.
Public forum comments: Speakers raised conditions in City Hall Park, drug and alcohol enforcement, and police accountability.

Curbside recycling ordinance: Staff said some large properties use dumpsters or self-haul to avoid the $12.01 monthly solid waste tax, a gap of about $130,000 a year. Members asked whether large apartment buildings could fit the required toters.
Winooski Valley Park District budget: Members asked about the district's funding formula and Burlington's 30% share of membership dues. The item was postponed so the district could present.
